items.hed: Yordan Alvarez swept the Edgar Martinez Outstanding DH Award and the Hank Aaron Award and made the All-MLB First Team at Wednesday night's MLB Awards in Las Vegas
items.insight: MLB.com reports Astros Hall of Famer Jeff Bagwell, presenting the Edgar Martinez award, joked he might have been the worst DH in history by comparison. Alvarez shares this year's Hank Aaron Award, given to the game's top offensive performers, with the Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong, and is also one of three finalists for American League MVP, with Thursday's announcement expected to break a run of Aaron Judge or Shohei Ohtani winning every year since 2021.
items.image_caption: Minute Maid Park (now Daikin Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Rockets host the Utah Jazz Friday night at Toyota Center in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game
items.insight: Houston enters off Wednesday's 115-108 win over Golden State, its official schedule shows, looking to build on an early-season run that has it near the top of the Western Conference. Friday's 8:30 p.m. Eastern tip against Utah counts toward NBA Cup group play as well as the regular standings.

items.hed: The Texans' Week 10 injury report still shows receivers Tank Dell and Marvin Harrison Jr. both limited ahead of Sunday's trip to Cleveland
items.insight: Houston's official injury report lists Dell (hand, shoulder) and Harrison (hamstring) as limited ahead of the 1 p.m. Eastern kickoff at Huntington Bank Field against the Browns. The team enters off an eight-sack defensive performance and a five-touchdown day from C.J. Stroud, so the health of both receivers will matter for whether that complete effort carries into Cleveland.
